title: Mathematical Modeling and Machine Learning for Biomedicine and Public Health
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Tribhuvan University
field: Mathematical biology, machine learning, public health
about: Ten-day CIMPA school at Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu, 31 May-9 June 2027, with lectures and computer labs on disease dynamics, stochastic modelling and machine learning with mechanistic models such as PINNs. Registration closes 31 January 2027.
requirements: CIMPA schools are aimed mainly at students and teacher-researchers in developing countries
Applications must be made via the CIMPA application site before the deadline on the school's page

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling I
why: "Machine learning" → "Build supervised learning models for regression and classification using methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and gradient boosting."
"Stochastic modelling" → "Compare predictive approaches according to the structure of the data, the analytical objective, and the assumptions of the modelling method."
